about: This is your task list. The app (Open Task List.html) and Claude both read and write this file.
Claude: read apps/task-list/CLAUDE.md before changing anything here.
Sections: settings, tasks, plan (today), week (goals), events (calendar copy), people, dump (brain dump), replies (emails to answer, with drafts), meetings (calls), triage (last check), activity.
Tasks marked "example": true are samples. Replace them with the person's real tasks during setup.
